summary: Manages project configuration, context, and workspace definitions, encapsulating settings parsed from configuration files and workspace structures.
responsibilities: Manage project configuration settings parsed from pyproject.toml files.
Encapsulate project context including roots, configurations, and loaders.
Define workspace configurations, roots, and constituent projects.
relationships: ProjectContext encapsulates PyProjectConfig and project metadata.
WorkspaceContext contains WorkspaceConfig and WorkspaceProject instances.
design_decisions: Encapsulates project context and workspace structures into object representations.
